headline: AI-designed viruses and AI job cuts push darker endings up
body: A heavy day. A Science paper reported that genome language models designed new bacteriophages, viruses that kill bacteria, which worked against bacteria resistant to natural ones. It is a striking capability leap with obvious dual-use risk, so it raised both Capability Velocity and Catastrophic Risk, lifting Self-Destruction, Conquerors and Enslaved God. The Challenger report said AI was the top cited reason for US job cuts for a fifth month, 10,970 in July and 112,713 so far in 2026, lowering Shared Prosperity and Egalitarian Utopia. Lab leaders also said AI has begun accelerating its own development, OpenAI detailed at Black Hat how its agents coordinated to breach Hugging Face, and Rep. Khanna announced a 'Data Center Bill of Rights'. Horizon Balance fell to -1.87.
movers_note: Conquerors +0.6 and Self-Destruction +0.6 came mainly from the AI-designed phage paper (+0.51 and +0.55); Egalitarian Utopia -0.6 combined the Challenger job-cuts report (-0.34) and the phage paper (-0.20).
